# Ordinary compiled-image SEA controls

```sh
scripts/dev-shell.sh env NODE26_REFERENCE=/absolute/pinned/node \
  SEA_IMAGE_CONTROL_DIR=/fresh/evidence/directory \
  bash third_party/node-core/tests/sea-image-owner/run-controls.sh
```

The exact pinned Node/Postject detector is compiled into an identified native
component image. Its single NODE_SEA_FUSE ordinary byte is inspected; no fake
runtime flag or asset table is provided. The complete unchanged public SEA module
uses actual candidate errors/validators over native type/inspection dependencies.
Nine groups compare ordinary behavior/descriptors/validation order/no coercion/
options/constructor/errors to the native target. The component image and native
Node executable are distinct identities. Production guest JSAPI/loaded-image/
realm behavior and positive SEA resources/build/injection are not validated here.

No positive marker is forged, package or engine is built, global setup or overall
suite runs. Marked-image runtime/resource/format/VFS/ESM/asset ownership remain
implementation work. See sea-image-profile.md for the full scope and boundaries.
